st: The perfect pasta, easier breastfeeding and Amazon's elves

sec.t: ff.6.1 100 gifts to put under the tree
sec.p: If you're still looking for something to put under the tree this Christmas, Time has published a list of the 100 best inventions of the year that (despite everything) has just gone by.

Obviously, to make sure every parcel is delivered by the 25th under the trees of billions of people, Santa Claus gets help from Amazon. Which in turn gets help from 150 thousand seasonal workers, hired over the holidays. Practically double all of Nike's employees.

sec.t: ff.6.3 The advent of shopping, around the world
sec.p: Every holiday has its spending. And if holidays aren't enough, we create new ones: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, the New Year sales and, in Asia, created by Alibaba, Singles' Day (11 November, sigh).

rel: ff.145 Sugar, bones and crème brûlée
